sources.entry: Easydict - A concise dictionary and translator for looking up words and translating text. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict)

summary.one_liner: Easydict is a macOS dictionary and translation app that looks up words or translates text across multiple translation, dictionary, and AI services at once.
summary.what_it_does: Easydict detects the language of input text automatically and supports input translation, mouse or shortcut selection translation, and screenshot translation with OCR. It also has a silent screenshot OCR mode that copies recognized text straight to the clipboard. Results from multiple services can be queried at the same time, including Apple Dictionary, MDict, Apple Translate, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Ollama, DeepL, Google, and Bing, with 20+ services in total. It offers multiple TTS voice services and 52 selectable translation languages.
use_cases: Look up word definitions on a Mac
Translate selected text in any app
Compare results from several translation services
Extract text from screen regions via OCR
Hear text pronounced with TTS voices
how_to_run: Or download the latest release manually (macOS 13.0+; for older systems use version 2.7.2)
notable: Queries multiple dictionary, translation, and AI services simultaneously
Silent screenshot OCR copies recognized text directly to the clipboard
Supports local-model and CLI services such as Ollama, Claude Code, and Codex CLI
caveats: Requires macOS 13.0+ for the latest version; older systems need version 2.7.2
Some services require their own access or API setup (see the services overview)
Maintainer has limited time, so issue triage may be slow
